items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: I heard Andy Kirk's band, and also Erskine Hawkins. ... I used to listen to the great records by Erskine Hawkins

ctx.x: Yeah. It was on North Farris Street in Jackson. That was the big dance hall where all the bands played. I had an opportunity to hear a lot of great bands, like Earl Hines, Tiny Bradshaw, (?), they had Joe Robicheaux -- a lot of different bands that came through there. I heard Andy Kirk's band, and also Erskine Hawkins. And we also had another ballroom called the Savoy Ballroom, and I used to play there on some matinees that they would have at the Savoy with Paul Gayten's little group. And we also used to…
